correctness.rationale: Each of the P plane and T affine-independent row supports is reduced by a rank-2 or rank-3 surjective character restriction. Every fiber has size u or v; the 70 local quadruples partition as 56 affine-independent det±8, two special parity planes det±16, and twelve deficient planes rank3. The occupancy counts for one, two, and three projection types are complete, with zero-binomial convention. An exact C++ enumeration confirmed all rank and determinant multiplicities at N=8 and N=16 (including 3,312,400 four-minor pairs at N=16). The Cauchy-Binet identity separately verifies the determinant-square sum: 64*count8 + 256*count16 = C(N,4)*N^4. This identity is checkable algebraically for arbitrary N from the formulas. Higher dimensions rest on the proof, not finite extrapolation.

value.rationale: Complete classification of four-site sampling/interpolation on the canonical binary Fourier transform includes all singular rank defects, every invertible but nonorthogonal configuration, exact multiplicities for any d and an affine-geometric local rule. The distinction between invertibility and orthogonality is structurally relevant to numerical sampling and sparse reconstruction; the count of determinant-eight minors follows in aggregate from existing orthogonal counts plus Cauchy--Binet, but the rank-1/2/3 deficit incidence and its per-row affine classification are not supplied by those ingredients. This is a natural finite complete classification rather than an arbitrary isolated parameter slice.
